github.copilot.chat.commitMessageGenerat.text: Prefix the subject with a Conventional Commits type such as feat:, fix:, refactor:, or chore:.
Write the subject line in imperative mood, keep it under 72 characters, and make it convey the primary change at a glance.
When a body is warranted, separate it from the subject with a blank line and express each point as a dash-prefixed bullet beginning with a past-tense verb (e.g. Added, Removed, Renamed).
Each bullet should capture a meaningful outcome or action; omit trivial or granular details like individual property additions.
Surround any code identifiers, file names, or paths with backticks.
Bullets must be purely factual — state what happened, never include reasoning, motivation, or justification.
